name: Alcalá del Valle (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcalá del Valle (a castle on blue and a tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Alcalá del Valle; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcalá del Valle arms — castle and tree
